name: HiringCafe
note: Browse and save jobs in your project browser. Apply through the original employer page; a public-search collector is not enabled here.

name: Wellfound
note: Create your candidate profile or sign in. Check each role's Hires Remotely From restrictions; saved sign-in does not enable automatic native applications.

name: Himalayas
note: Sign in on the website. Verify India eligibility and timezone restrictions for each job; no automatic search feed is enabled here.

name: Y Combinator Jobs · Work at a Startup
note: Create or access your startup candidate profile in the project browser. This is the startup jobs board, not vacancies at YC itself.

name: We Work Remotely
note: Access your job-seeker account in the project browser. Check country eligibility and any access terms directly on the site.

name: Welcome to the Jungle
note: Create your profile or sign in on the official website. Employer forms and native site applications have different requirements.

name: ZipRecruiter
note: Sign in or create a job-seeker account. Public search is already available in Job portals; geographic coverage and eligibility vary.

name: Naukri
note: Sign in or create a candidate account. One-click applications may use the resume saved in Naukri.

name: LinkedIn
note: Saved browser session for your use. Automated applications use employer pages.

name: Indeed
note: Sign in on the website. Employer application links are used by the project.

name: Glassdoor
note: Sign in on the website. Account access does not enable automated submissions.

name: HirePro employer portal
note: Paste the employer's actual HirePro registration/application link. Accounts may be employer-specific.

name: Workday employer portal
note: Paste a company's candidate portal URL. Each employer may require a separate account.

name: Greenhouse employer form
note: Paste the actual employer job link. Many forms do not require an account.

name: Lever employer form
note: Paste the employer's original job link. Shared candidate login is not assumed.

name: Ashby employer form
note: Paste an employer application URL; sign-in requirements vary.

name: Mercor
note: Use your own account and complete interviews or assessments yourself.

name: Turing
note: Programme eligibility and assessments are managed by the platform.

name: micro1
note: Create or access your account through the official website.

name: Outlier
note: Identity verification, tests and account setup remain manual.

name: Upwork
note: Saved login for manual use. The project does not automatically send proposals.

name: Fiverr
note: Manage the account in the project browser; no automated marketplace posting is enabled.

name: Freelancer
note: Sign in on the website and submit proposals manually.

name: PeoplePerHour
note: Saved browser login; no automatic proposal submission.

name: Google sign-in
note: Optional project account for sites offering Google sign-in. The project does not read your password or send email.
